intro: During the Feast of Winter Veil, the performer portraying Greatfather Winter in Ironforge grows tired and asks passersby for a seasonal treat. Bringing him freshly baked gingerbread cookies and ice cold milk earns a festive reward and his warm gratitude.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hey, can you do Greatfather Winter a favor, um, little kid?

Not to needlessly talk about myself in the third person, but Greatfather Winter has been at this all day and he could use a treat himself. Some gingerbread cookies and ice cold milk to wash them down with would really hit the spot. Think you could be a friend to the Greatfather and fetch some for me?

clips.title: Progress
paras: All this talk of treats has given me a hankering for some myself. Mmmm... Gingerbread cookies and milk...

clips.title: Completion
paras: You're quite the helper to ol' Greatfather Winter there, friend. Have a great Feast of Winter Veil.
Here's a little something... You know, for the effort.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
